01 · from the heart

A little thank you to an awesome friend ♡

Not just a birthday wish — a reminder of how much the friendship means.

First of all, HAPPY BIRTHDAY, SUMAIYA! 🥳🎂❤️

I wanted to make you something a little different: a small collection of appreciation, laughter, memories, and the random madness that makes our friendship so much fun.

You're one of those people who can turn an ordinary day into an adventure. You have your own style, your own opinions, and a very impressive ability to make sure the world knows exactly what you think. 😂 Your “meto apne maan ka karungi” attitude deserves its own award — and yes, I am still going to tease you, because suddenly becoming serious and sensible would be suspicious.

Jokes aside, let's get one thing straight: you're genuinely beautiful. That smile, those eyes, the way you carry yourself — and yes, the hotness too. It's honestly a little unfair to the rest of us. 😂 You can pretend you don't know it, but I refuse to participate in that particular lie. If you ever look in the mirror and think you don't look amazing, please check the lighting… or your eyesight. The mirror is clearly being more honest than you are. 😌❤️

And before you accuse me of exaggerating: no, madam, this is not flattery. This is a highly scientific observation, independently verified by the birthday committee (which is just me, but still). 😂

Want to plan a trip? YES. Explore somewhere new? ABSOLUTELY. Roam around without a perfect itinerary or a fixed return time? That's practically our speciality. I hope we never lose that adventurous side — the unplanned detours, the random conversations, the food stops, the photos, and the stories we'll laugh about years later.

I know I'm not always the most attentive friend, and there may have been moments when I could have been more present. But please know that your friendship genuinely matters to me. I admire your strength, your fearless spirit, and the way you keep being unapologetically yourself.

For this year, I wish you happiness, good health, peaceful days, unexpected opportunities, beautiful places to explore, and people who make you feel appreciated. May you achieve the things you're quietly dreaming about, laugh until your stomach hurts, and collect moments that make you think, “That was a beautiful day.”

Thank you for being you, for being a good friend, and for being my always-ready-to-explore partner. Here's to more trips, more laughter, more ridiculous conversations, and many more memories together. And please stay exactly this confident, gorgeous, slightly impossible version of yourself. The world has enough ordinary people; it needs your particular brand of chaos. 💜

One final clarification: if you say “I'm not looking good” after looking this good, I will respectfully disagree, present photographic evidence, and overrule your complaint. That's not gaslighting; that's quality control. 😂

With lots of appreciation (and unlimited teasing),
A friend ♡
02 · ten very valid reasons

10 things I love about you 💜

A little appreciation, a little teasing, and ten reminders of what makes you unmistakably you. Tap each one to open it.

You're stronger than you sometimes give yourself credit for. You face things head-on and keep moving, even when the road gets difficult. That stubborn warrior spirit is genuinely admirable — even if sometimes it looks like you're preparing for battle over the smallest inconvenience. 😂

You carry yourself with confidence and a proper main-character energy. You know your mind, you have your standards, and you don't need a committee's permission to be yourself. Humility may occasionally be on leave, but the confidence is iconic. 🤣

Some people need a motivational speech. You have your own legendary one-liners — especially “Gand maar lungi uski!” The delivery, the confidence, the dramatic pause… unforgettable. The world has been formally warned. 😂

You're always ready to explore somewhere new. Random destinations, scenic roads, unplanned stops, and “let's just go” energy — that's one of the best things about you. The plan can come later; the adventure comes first.

With you, an ordinary day rarely stays ordinary. There's always a surprise, a new idea, or a plot twist nobody ordered. Life would be a lot quieter without your chaos — and honestly, a lot less entertaining.

You don't just experience a situation; you produce the entire season. A tiny inconvenience gets a soundtrack, a backstory, and a dramatic finale. Netflix should probably be paying you royalties by now.

Advice is received, reviewed, and then… the final decision is still yours. You have a mind of your own, and you are absolutely going to use it. “Meto apne maan ka karungi” isn't just a line; it's the official closing statement. Case closed.

You have a way of stepping into new experiences without waiting for everything to be perfect. That boldness makes you fun to travel with, fun to talk to, and someone who reminds others to live a little more freely.

You bring your real self into the room — your opinions, your laughter, your moods, your random thoughts. There's something refreshing about a person who doesn't try to be a copy of anyone else. Keep that honesty and individuality.

Beyond the warrior, the baddie, and the drama queen is a person with a good heart who deserves happiness, kindness, and beautiful experiences. That's the part I hope you never forget: you're appreciated for who you are, not just for the entertainment you provide.

“50% warrior, 30% drama queen, 20% unnecessary chaos… and 100% impossible to replace.” 😂💜
